TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Balabac Strait
DATE 23 November 2028 · 0530 local
SIDE Philippine Navy
WINDOW 130 min, closes at 195
Tarlac class landing platform dock. Photo: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Daniel B... · CC BY-SA 4.0 · cropped

BALABAC STRAIT, 0530, 23 NOVEMBER. At 0300 Beijing announced the closure of the southern passages to coalition shipping 'for the period of the negotiations'. The southern surface group - a Type 052D, two Type 054A and two Type 056A - is in the South China Sea seventy miles west of the strait, coming east. A JH-7A strike regiment is airborne from Mischief Reef.

The convoy for Balabac and the Sulu is at the anchorage east of the strait. If the surface group gets through, it closes the island road from the west, and everything the group has fought for since October goes with it.

Hold the strait. Three of the five ships sunk will turn the group back. Your ships are weapons Free. There is no rearm after this: what is in the magazines and the supply ships is the whole war. A submarine was reported in the strait two days ago and has not been seen since.
Naval Forces West
COMMANDER'S INTENT

The strait stays open and the convoy at the anchorage stays afloat. The surface group has been ordered to close the strait and will fire to do it; you are weapons Free. Sink three of its five ships and it turns back. Keep your supply ships out of the fight and close enough to reach - this is what they were for.
• Sink three of the five ships of the surface group
• Keep the convoy at the anchorage afloat
• Sink the Type 052D
• Harm no fishing boat

Your task group, its aircraft and its supply ships. At the anchorage: the Balabac convoy. Opposing: a Type 052D, two Type 054A and two Type 056A, a JH-7A strike regiment and possibly a Type 039C submarine. Neutral: fishing boats.

The planned window is 130 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 65 minutes more; the operation is closed at 195 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
